plugins.photosPermission: Allow Foodyzz to access your photos so you can upload your driver license.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Foodyzz to use your camera to photograph your driver license and take your selfie.

android.extraProguardRules:
# R8 runs on release builds, which is what Play's DEX code optimization
# check measures. React Native, Firebase, Stripe and the Expo modules each
# ship consumer rules inside their AARs; these cover the gaps those leave.
# Kept deliberately narrow — every -keep is a class R8 may not rename, and
# Play reads the obfuscated share of the bundle.

# Anything C++ looks up by name has to keep that name.
-keepclasseswithmembernames,includedescriptorclasses class * { native <methods>; }

# Reanimated drives views from its own JNI layer.
-keep class com.swmansion.reanimated.** { *; }
-keep class com.facebook.react.turbomodule.** { *; }

# Optional backends these libraries reference but do not bundle.
-dontwarn javax.annotation.**
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**

# Stripe ships push provisioning (adding a card to the Google Pay wallet)
# as a separate artifact neither app pulls in, but the React Native wrapper
# references it unconditionally. R8 lists these as missing classes.
-dontwarn com.stripe.android.pushProvisioning.**

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Foodyzz checks your location once, while you are at your delivery address, to confirm where your bike will be delivered.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to photograph your driver license for bike rental verification.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) does not record audio. Microphone access is included by an audio library used only to play notification sounds.
